thm:scc-rh-equivalence.reviewer_note: K0+F4 GATES (2026-07-03, upd. MIG-022): inherits prop:rh-kernel-positivity defects D1-D3 PLUS its own D4 (Mellin-Plancherel domain error): the proof claims Gaussians fail SCC-M4, but psi_gamma=e^{-(tau-gamma)^2} IS the Mellin transform of an explicit L^2(dx/x) function (verified); Gaussians fail only SCC-M3 as written. Also F4: trivial probe space under current Def; restriction-only converse gap. Kernel/multiplier mismatch visible in this theorem's own display. Gated on RH-K0 then RH-P0.

thm:rh-s1-conditional.reviewer_note: Inherits K0 gate (via thm:scc-rh-equivalence <- prop:rh-kernel-positivity) and F4 gate. Formally intact [C] implication; usable force gated on K0 then P0.

def:rh-kernel.reviewer_note: K0 GATE (2026-07-03): F is declared as a difference kernel K(t,u)=F(t-u) but used downstream as a spectral multiplier (Q=int F|psi|^2); the displayed zero-sum has a sign error (leading minus makes sigma>1/2 contributions POSITIVE) and functional-equation partners rho and 1-conj(rho) cancel exactly in the displayed Re sum. Regularization (zeta'/zeta '~') undefined. See RESEARCH_PACKET_RH_K0.md.

prop:rh-kernel-positivity.reviewer_note: K0 GATE (2026-07-03): three independent defects verified against the text: (1) proof asserts 'negative bump' for sigma>1/2 but the definition's leading minus makes that contribution positive; (2) partner zeros at 1-sigma+i*gamma cancel it exactly (Re xi'/xi vanishes on the critical line off zeros, RH or not), so the displayed sum cannot detect off-critical pairs; (3) even granting a bump, a positive-definite function may take negative values (cos t), so the equivalence step is invalid for the declared difference kernel. [C] proposition's claimed equivalence is unestablished as written. See RESEARCH_PACKET_RH_K0.md.

rem:scc-rh-governance.reviewer_note: D4/K0 GATE (2026-07-03): this remark repeats (a) that the Theorem 'establishes' the RH equivalence (unestablished as written: defects D1-D3) and (b) that the M1-M4 restriction 'excludes artificial localization probes' - the theorem's Gaussian-exclusion argument is wrong on M4 (D4, Mellin-Plancherel domain error: psi_gamma = Mellin of f_gamma(x)=(1/(2 sqrt(pi))) x^{-i gamma} exp(-(log x)^2/4) in L^2(dx/x), verified). Gaussians fail only SCC-M3 as written; M2 undecidable until formalized. Gated on RH-K0.
